result:
Not every screen is at 4 or more from the critic. Of the ten I re-shot and re-judged, none improved. Screens 27–31, 68, 69, 71 and 73 were never shot or judged this run.

I shipped two changes. Both passed the gate, the seed 4242 fingerprint is unchanged, and both are logged in `notes\ui\changes.md`.

- **v31.49 (cw-pset8):**
  - The settings key hint now ends under the X.
  - The row under the pointer gets a 4px lime bar, a brighter label and lime arrows.
  - The report-a-problem box now uses the same button type as the other pause buttons.
  - Abandon is a quiet red text button until it asks to confirm.
- **v31.54 (cw-pset9):**
  - The pad buttons table is 1440 wide instead of 960.
  - The pointed settings row has a lighter fill and a 1px lime outline.
  - Both lists fade out over 48px, with 48px under the last row.

The scores below are before and after v31.49. v31.54 was judged only on 72 and 74.

| Screen | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| 72 (settings display tab) | 3 | 3 |
| 25 (raid pause box) | 3 | 3 |
| 74 (pad buttons) | 2 | 2 |

The critic said 72 and 25 were slightly better, but the score did not move. After two follow-ups with no gain, I stopped on 74 and wrote down what is stuck. Both ships went through the gate, so none of this is blocked by it.

What the critic keeps asking for:
- **Settings (18, 72):** a wider list or a left tab rail. That conflicts with his Q43 order and the earlier "keep the label next to its stepper" rule, so I left the 960 column alone.
- **Pad buttons (74, 75):**
  - A focused key chip in the shot. That needs a pad-focus staging entry in `ui-screens-js.json`, and I'm only allowed to add one by asking in `questions.md`. I did not ask this run.
  - The "locked: these keep their jobs" line is still cut at the scroll end.
  - Small sub-labels for the "(hold: …)" text.
- **Pause boxes (25, 42, 49):** report, feedback and what's new as one row of three quiet buttons, plus an esc hint on resume. I did not build this.

Notes are in `notes\c-31-ui-pause-settings.md`. Pictures are in `shots\c-31w-before`, `c-31w-after` and `c-31w-after2`.

TASK PARTIAL: 72 and 25 are at 3 and 74 is at 2. Screens 27–31, 68, 69, 71 and 73 have never been judged. Still to build: the pause button rows, the pad-focus staging, a settings tab rail, the pad label sub-lines, and snapping the lists to whole rows.
